say:55:1460307041:1.female: Well, one thing's for sure, a new success guru is rising in Sal'thorin.

say:56:1460307042:1.text: On the bright side, it's a bit fun to shake things up for Ravion and Indris—spice up their monotonous lives a little, right?
say:56:1460307042:1.source_cn: 咳……往好里想想，适当地给沙利叶和因度厄添点小麻烦，调...

say:57:1460307035:1.text: Doesn't matter! No matter the challenge, I'll always hold my head high!
say:57:1460307035:1.source_cn: 无妨！无论面对何等困难，我都会始终昂着头！
say:57:1460307035:1.male: Doesn't matter! No matter the challenge, I'll always hold my head high!
say:57:1460307035:1.female: Doesn't matter! No matter the challenge, I'll always hold my head high!

say:66:1460307004:1.text: My professor always told me, "Don't look down, or your crown will fall! Keep your head up—that's how winners walk!"
say:66:1460307004:1.source_cn: 老师说了，别低头，王冠会掉！昂着头，才是成功者的姿态！
